headline: Electro-Alfa International enters the BET index six months after listing on the BVB - Forbes.ro
summary: Electro-Alfa International has entered the BET index six months after listing on the Bucharest Stock Exchange. The source gives no further details on the index change.
why: The BET is the benchmark index of the Bucharest Stock Exchange, and index inclusion can affect demand for a listed company's shares from index-tracking funds.
